# Marin Lazic

> Performance coach for founders, training and recovery. Strength and Conditioning Coach for the Australian Men's Water Polo Team (the Aussie Sharks) and founder of Otion. Sydney, coaching online.

Last updated: 2026-10-16

## Who Marin Lazic is

Marin Lazic is the National Lead Strength and Conditioning Coach for the Australian Men's Water Polo Team, a role he has held since October 2021. He prepared the team for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games and for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 World Championships in Fukuoka, Doha and Singapore. He now supports the LA28 pathway. He first worked with the Australian national water polo program in 2015 during preparation for the Rio Olympics.

He has 15 years of experience in strength and conditioning. He holds ASCA Level 2 accreditation (Australian Strength and Conditioning Association) and a Certificate IV in Fitness. He was a TRX Master Instructor from 2008 to 2023 and a Trigger Point Master Trainer from 2012 to 2021.

As an athlete he played for the New Zealand Men's National Water Polo Team and in the Australian Water Polo League for Balmain Tigers, Drummoyne Devils and West Magpies. He trained under Hungarian coach Dénes Kemény.

He founded Otion in September 2023. Otion delivers health and performance coaching to founders, executives and organisations. He is based on Sydney's Northern Beaches, Australia.

## Services and pricing

- 1:1 executive performance coaching: $2,400 AUD per month, minimum 3 months. Delivered online. Programs run in Bridge Athletic. Apply at https://marinlazic.com/apply. No sales call. Marin reviews every application and replies by email.
- Free online Performance Assessment: 27 questions, about 5 minutes, produces a coaching score across sleep, stress, training, recovery, nutrition and injuries plus an AI assisted report. Not a clinical diagnosis. https://marinlazic.com/assessment
- Athlete performance programming for water polo and other sports.
- Corporate health and performance programs through Otion: https://marinlazic.com/corporate-health-performance
- Travel and jet lag protocols for athletes and professionals crossing time zones.

Coaching is education and training support. It is not medical diagnosis or treatment.

## Common questions

Q: Who is Marin Lazic?
A: Marin Lazic is a performance coach for founders, training and recovery. He is the Strength and Conditioning Coach for the Australian Men's Water Polo Team and the founder of Otion. He coaches from Sydney, online.

Q: What is executive health and performance coaching?
A: A practical plan for strength, aerobic fitness, sleep and recovery, adapted to your workload, training history and progress. It does not replace medical care.

Q: How much does coaching with Marin Lazic cost?
A: $2,400 AUD per month with a minimum commitment of 3 months. The online Performance Assessment is free.

Q: Is coaching delivered online?
A: Yes. Programs run in Bridge Athletic with direct communication by email and message. Marin is based in Sydney.

Q: What are Marin's qualifications?
A: ASCA Level 2 accreditation, Certificate IV in Fitness, former TRX Master Instructor and Trigger Point Master Trainer, 15 years in strength and conditioning, four international campaigns with the Australian Men's Water Polo Team including the Paris 2024 Olympic Games.

Q: How do I apply for coaching?
A: Complete the short application at https://marinlazic.com/apply. Marin reviews it personally and replies by email. No sales call.

Q: What is Otion?
A: Otion is Marin Lazic's health and performance company, founded in 2023. It delivers coaching programs to founders, executives and organisations.
